params.name: age_of_people
params.description: Filter based on the age of individuals in an image.

params.name: artists
params.description: Search for images by specific artists (free-text, comma-separated list of artists).

params.name: collection_codes
params.description: Filter by collections (comma-separated list of collection codes). Include or exclude based on collections_filter_type.

params.name: collections_filter_type
params.description: Use to include or exclude collections from search. The default is include

params.name: compositions
params.description: Filter based on image composition.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Return only images that are created on or after this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., 1999-12-31).

params.name: date_to
params.description: Return only images that are created on or before this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., 1999-12-31).

params.name: download_product
params.description:
Filters based on which product the asset will download against.
                    Allowed values are easyaccess, editorialsubscription, imagepack, premiumaccess and royaltyfreesubscription.
                    If you have more than one instance of a product, you may also include the ID of the product instance you wish to filter on. 
                    For example, some users may have more than one premiumaccess product, so the download_product value would be premiumaccess:1234. 
                    Product ID can be obtained from the GET /products response.

params.name: editorial_segments
params.description: Return only events with a matching editorial segment.

params.name: embed_content_only
params.description: Restrict search results to embeddable images. The default is false.

params.name: ethnicity
params.description: Filter search results based on the ethnicity of individuals in an image.

params.name: event_ids
params.description: Filter based on specific events

params.name: exclude_keyword_ids
params.description: Return only images not tagged with specific keyword(s). Specify using a comma-separated list of keyword Ids. If keyword Ids and phrase are both specified, only those images matching the query phrase which also do not contain the requested keyword(s) are returned.

params.name: fields
params.description: Specifies fields to return. Defaults to 'summary_set'. NOTE: Bytes, height, and width returned by 'download_sizes' field are estimates.

params.name: file_types
params.description: Return only images having a specific file type.

params.name: graphical_styles
params.description: Filter based on graphical style of the image.

params.name: graphical_styles_filter_type
params.description: Provides searching based on specified graphical style(s). The default is include.

params.name: include_related_searches
params.description: Specifies whether or not to include related searches in the response. The default is false.

params.name: keyword_ids
params.description: Return only images tagged with specific keyword(s). Specify using a comma-separated list of keyword Ids. If keyword Ids and phrase are both specified, only those images matching the query phrase which also contain the requested keyword(s) are returned.

params.name: minimum_size
params.description: Filter based on minimum size requested. The default is x-small.

params.name: number_of_people
params.description: Filter based on the number of people in the image.

params.name: orientations
params.description: Return only images with selected aspect ratios.

params.name: page
params.description: Request results starting at a page number (default is 1).

params.name: page_size
params.description: Request number of images to return in each page. Default is 30, maximum page_size is 100.

params.name: phrase
params.description: Search images using a search phrase.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Select sort order of results.  The default is best_match

params.name: specific_people
params.description: Return only images associated with specific people (using a comma-delimited list).

params.name: minimum_quality_rank
params.description: Filter search results based on minimum quality ranking. Possible values 1, 2, 3 with 1 being best.

params.name: facet_fields
params.description:
Specifies the facets to return in the response. Facets provide additional search parameters to refine your results.
                   The include_facets parameter must be set to "true" for facets to be returned.

params.name: include_facets
params.description: Specifies whether or not to include facets in the result set. Default is "false".

params.name: facet_max_count
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of facets to return per type. Default is 300.
